evidence.notes:
phase_19_hosted_spa_static_fix: EXACTLY TWO CARDS on operator authorization 2026-10-22 ("repair both, open separate cards, follow the standard process"). Both defects were reproduced against the LIVE host at survey before any scoping, and both are hosted static-asset defects invisible to every existing gate.

D1 -> t109 (issue 115): GET /assets/index-DpxkfWRY.js answers 404 application/json while GET /assets/assets/index-DpxkfWRY.js answers 200 text/javascript 772815 bytes; /login and /index.html return 200 with the correct shell and the page renders BLANK. The doubled assets/ segment is the diagnosis: register_spa_static mounts the WHOLE copied Vite dist at SPA_MOUNT_PATH="/assets", so URL /assets/<hashed>.js resolves to backend/static/<hashed>.js and the inner assets/ hop is missing. THE MOUNT POINT IS CORRECT; THE MOUNTED DIRECTORY IS ONE LEVEL TOO HIGH.
D2 -> t110 (issue 116): create_app registers GET / returning {"status": "ok"} BEFORE the SPA catch-all, so the bare deployed URL shows JSON - which is what the operator saw and reasonably read as a broken site. /api/v1/health is unaffected.

WHY THE GREEN PIPELINE MISSED IT (the pipeline is not broken and is not blamed): (a) the _build_static fixture wrote its asset at the static ROOT and asserted GET /assets/app.js == 200, so the fixture shape DISAGREED with real Vite output while the test passed honestly against a false premise; (b) the E2E suite runs the Vite DEV server on :5173 and never traverses the single-container static path; (c) all six hosted legs (t26/t41/t57/t58/t59/t70) probe /api/v1/health and README text and none fetches a frontend asset; (d) leg 130 (t24 ac6, 0-based) greps the frozen literal SPA_MOUNT_PATH == "/assets", which remains TRUE after the fix - the frozen literal is not the bug. t109 therefore repairs the PREMISE (re-shape the fixture to the real dist layout) rather than relaxing any frozen assertion.

SURFACE OVERLAP RESOLVED EXPLICITLY (both cards touch backend/app/main.py): the chosen option is a DISJOINT BUILD CARVE plus a SERIALIZED MERGE. t109 owns the static-directory resolution inside register_spa_static and backend/tests/unit/test_static_serving.py; t110 owns ONLY the GET / handler region (delimited at run time by two frozen lines, located by exact match with a loud failure if either moves), its own new test file, README.md and the verifier constants it re-premises. Option (A) alone was rejected because t110's claim is COMPOSITE - a root document whose every bundle 404s is the same blank page one URL earlier, so it cannot be measured on broken-asset bytes; hence t110 depends_on t109 for the merge window while build may run in parallel. Non-interference is PROVEN, not assumed: each card's ownership fence byte-compares the sibling's surface to a run-time-derived base, and where a sibling surface is legitimately dirty the fence verifies that the SIBLING'S CLAIM still survives rather than byte-freezing a moving target (a freeze would RED whichever card merges second, which is not monotone-safe for fences that run forever).

OPTIONAL-INDEX-QUESTION RULED: NO index write on either card, so the WAL 1248 W2 eight-property index-amendment policy is NOT invoked and the OTHER card touches ZERO index bytes (proven as a zero-diff against a run-time-derived base AND against the working tree, so an uncommitted append is still caught). Closure for D1 rides on leg 130 executing the re-shaped fixture plus a fence that stages a REAL Vite-shaped static tree (index.html at the root plus assets/<hashed>.js) and asserts that every URL the staged index.html references answers 200 with a script or stylesheet content type through a TestClient wired exactly as production wires it. A fixture that mirrors Vite truth is acceptable; a fixture that invents its own layout is precisely the bug being fixed.

NUMBERING CONVENTION (WAL 1240 W2): every leg number in this run is a 0-BASED index into the tests array of docs/state/merge_test_index.json and always travels with its issue_id and ac; the orchestrator sweep runner prints 1-based ordinals.

HARD CONSTRAINTS CARRIED INTO BOTH CARDS AS WRITTEN ACs: leg 130's frozen greps and its three pytest node IDs stay GREEN (the mount point stays /assets); openapi.yaml stays byte-frozen at zero bytes of diff, so the mount and the catch-all stay out of the schema; the route-free premise holds on the committed tree (no build output committed, create_app registers NO Mount, exactly one / route, /openapi.json and /api/v1/health answer 200, an unknown path 404s) - which is why t110 was scoped to change what the ONE existing root route RETURNS rather than how many routes exist, needing no written amendment to any frozen assertion; and t78's metrics surface plus /metrics and /api/v1/* must not be swallowed by mount ordering. README.md is TRIPLE-PINNED and managed, so its live-URL guidance edit (point readers at /api/v1/health as the operational probe rather than the bare root, which is what misled the operator) is bounded by written ACs: LINE-NEUTRAL, 396 lines preserved, 17 level-2 headings preserved, ASCII-clean, the 64-hex literal count in docs_verification.py held at exactly 13, and README_DIGEST plus the regenerated docs/criteria/docs_verification.md re-measured to SHIPPED bytes per the t96/t100 precedent.

ONE PRE-EXISTING DRIFT IS REPAIRED IN-CARD AND DISCLOSED: docs_verification.py --check is RED on main tip because CARRIED_DIGESTS['docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md'] still carries the t35-era digest while fe314d6 (t103) regenerated that evidence document. Leg 258 (t71 ac4, 0-based) requires the regenerated report to end ALL_CHECKS_PASS, so no README pin move can ship green until that digest is re-premised; the verifier RE-ATTESTS carried reports and must never rewrite them, so the generator side moves - the exact t100 re-premise-not-relax precedent.
